body.message:
Hello Sheza,

We completely understand your concern. If the extension had been confirmed earlier or the payment had been made in advance, the rate would have remained the same.

However, the management has now updated the policy, and all in-house guest extensions will have a 20% increase based on the current rate.

Therefore, for the month of August, the extension rate will be AED 6,600 for 30 nights.

If you would like to secure the same rate for September as well, we kindly request you to make at least 50% of the payment in advance to confirm the extension until September.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
